description: Get full product details by PID (branded pricing; plus a `wholesale` block with the unbranded/no-setup ladder where the supplier publishes bare stock). `locale` localises the product name, currency, pricing and URL (en-AU, en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP); descriptions are English for all locales.
